drone|.answer:
The decision is ADJUST.

You can spray 23.59 of 24.07 acres by drone, with 0.48 acres excluded as water itself with no extra buffer, because the label says "Do not apply directly to water, to areas where surface water is present or to intertidal areas below the mean high water mark."

A spot spray weed map would spray 9.73 acres, using a model set to catch 85% of spurge plots that found 90% on held-out plots and also flagged 10% of clean ones.

Warnings: 1 label rule could not be verified and was not applied, so check the label yourself. Drone imagery is missing for 1% of the block, so spurge there is unmapped and those cells are not sprayed, so scout them before the job.

rules.summary: Do not apply directly to water, surface water areas, or intertidal areas.
rules.quote: Do not apply directly to water, to areas where surface water is present or to intertidal areas below the mean high water mark.

rules.summary: Do not apply when conditions favor movement from the treatment site.
rules.quote: Do not make application when circumstances favor movement from treatment site.

rules.summary: Do not apply through any irrigation system.
rules.quote: Do not apply this product through any type of irrigation system.

rules.summary: Do not apply to snow or frozen ground.
rules.quote: Do not apply to snow or frozen ground.

rules.summary: Do not apply through a mist blower.
rules.quote: Do not apply this product through a mist blower.

rules.summary: Outer nozzles must not exceed three-quarters of wingspan or 90 percent of rotor width.
rules.quote: The distance of the outer most operating nozzles on the boom must not exceed 3/4 the length of the wingspan or 90% of rotor width.

rules.summary: Point nozzles backward parallel to the airstream and not more than 45 degrees downward.
rules.quote: Nozzles must always point backward parallel with the air stream and never be pointed downwards more than 45 degrees.

rules.summary: Do not spray more than 10 feet above the tallest plants unless required for safety.
rules.quote: Applications should not be made at a height greater than 10 feet above the top of the largest plants unless a greater height is required for aircraft safety.

rules.summary: Avoid application when wind speed is below 2 mph.
rules.quote: Application should be avoided below 2 mph due to variable wind direction and high inversion potential.

rules.summary: Do not apply during a temperature inversion.
rules.quote: Applications should not occur during a temperature inversion because drift potential is high.

rules.summary: Apply in at least 2 gallons of spray per acre by air.
rules.quote: Apply Tordon 22K as a coarse low-pressure spray at the specified rates in a spray volume of 2 or more gallons per acre by air or 10 or more gallons per acre by ground.

rules.summary: Apply in at least 10 gallons of spray per acre by ground.
rules.quote: Apply Tordon 22K as a coarse low-pressure spray at the specified rates in a spray volume of 2 or more gallons per acre by air or 10 or more gallons per acre by ground.

rules.summary: Do not exceed 2 quarts per acre per year on non-cropland.
rules.quote: Total use of Tordon 22K, including retreatments or spot treatments, must not exceed 1.0 lb a.i. picloram (2 quarts) per acre per annual growing season on rights-of-way and other non-crop areas.

rules.summary: Do not exceed 1 pint per acre per year as a fallow broadcast treatment.
rules.quote: Do not apply more than 1 pint per acre as a broadcast treatment per annual growing season.

rules.summary: Do not exceed 1.5 fluid ounces per acre during the small grain season.
rules.quote: Do not apply more than 1-1/2 fluid ounces of Tordon 22K per acre during the small grain growing season.
